description: [hackernews] Full-text search of Hacker News stories (not comments) by keyword, ranked by relevance. Use this to find discussions about a product, project or topic; use hackernews_front_page for what is trending now. Returns title, url, points, comment count, date and story id.

query.description: Keywords to match in story titles and text, e.g. 'model context protocol'
